title: iproute2 commit 0dc34c77 — Add processless network namespace support

claims_extracted.claim: The commit adds the named/processless `ip netns` command family: add, delete, monitor, list and exec, plus `ip link set DEV netns NAME`.
claims_extracted.locator: commit message; ip/ip.c dispatch diff; new ip/ipnetns.c

claims_extracted.claim: Named namespace handles are opened from /var/run/netns/<NAME>; namespace-specific configuration can live under /etc/netns/<name>.
claims_extracted.locator: commit message; new ip/ipnetns.c constants and helper paths

claims_extracted.claim: `ip netns exec` enters the network namespace, creates a mount namespace, remounts /sys and bind-mounts namespace-specific configuration into standard /etc locations.
claims_extracted.locator: commit message; netns_exec and bind_etc in new ip/ipnetns.c
claims_extracted.notes: Userspace execution-environment behavior, not a statement about kernel namespace merge chronology.

notes: Exact upstream introduction of the named/processless command family. The source does not establish first deployment or first packaged distribution.
